product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Diya Holder Set
product_description: Add festive elegance to your home with this handcrafted diya holder featuring vibrant pink lotus petals, intricate golden detailing, pearl embellishments, and six golden diya holders. Perfect for Diwali celebrations, pooja rituals, and traditional festive decor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep decorative fabric and pearl embellishments away from direct heat.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface when lighting diyas.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
